evidence: All 26 criteria were read (2 gate, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual). Every gate/functional/polish criterion names concrete browser-observable outcomes with a distinctive JUDGE-* probe (none of the JUDGE literals occur in the seed or golden markup; grep of seed_data.json, server.js and public/* for JUDGE- returned nothing) and durable evidence: reload or second-context readback (constraints gate JUDGE-G1 reload + Harriet context; nested_replies leg 3 as Gwen after reload; hold_scope leg 2 for Gwen after reload; escape_closes and delete_confirm after reload; timer_changes leg 5 'as Harriet after a reload M-13 still shows 30 days'; persistence before/after restart_app with noted counts), and time-held evidence where the brief requires it (link_highlight and refusal_in_place 'still ... after about ten seconds'; live/unread legs 'within about ten seconds, without reloading'). Response-level legs are never bare shape assertions: each replay is paired with a recorded successful UI request and a state re-read (e.g. wall_every_route leg 5 'JUDGE-W2 appears nowhere, neither in M-11 for Dev or harriet... nor in M-12 for Sian'; signin_and_client_scope Part B 'check as harriet that M-12 has no JUDGE-CS1'; timer_changes leg 2 accepts not-available/error/empty as long as neither '2,400' nor '4,200' appears). Measurements are explicit where needed (polish transcript_print 'documentElement.scrollWidth equals the viewport width'). Seed-dependent outcomes are exact and derivable: K-10 at 2026-05-05T11:00:00Z exactly 7 days old vs K-11 one second younger; K-13 probate (8 days) and K-18 costs (9 days) vs held K-7 on the 30->7 day change; K-2 versions 'Landlords notice recieved.'; K-17 held overdue 'Insurer letter acknowledged.'. No criterion asks for a source read; prompts forbid guessed routes and require recorded requests. Visual criteria are anchored 0-5 likert craft judgements of named screens (matter list, M-13 hold/timer marks, M-11 transcript, 390x844 thread), which the skill treats as the correct format for the visual dimension rather than a 'looks right' defect. Runtime: the scripted Playwright golden run (golden-run.log, hashes verified against the index and frozen sources) executed every functional and polish criterion's steps and reports PASS for all 16 functional criteria, persistence_before/persistence, the constraints gate and all 6 polish criteria, which shows the steps are browser-executable and decidable on the golden. Residual risks (why risk=true): (1) no configured judge run of these bytes exists (index scope: 'A full configured grading run of this candidate ... are absent'), so LLM-judge decidability is unmeasured; (2) unread_and_new_messages_line does not pin which view Dev's second context or Gwen land on: a conforming design that auto-opens the most recently active matter on sign-in (golden does not; app.js:131-132 shows an empty view) would mark M-13 read and could fail leg 1 for the second context or leg 4 ('Gwen ... at least 2'); (3) live_updates_keep_my_work says 'the thread has not jumped' without telling the judge to note the scroll offset before Harriet's changes; (4) 'plain not-available' in signin_and_client_scope Part B and wall_every_route leg 3 is judged from response bodies and relies on the brief's wording rather than a defined shape. None of these is a demonstrated mis-grade, so they are recorded as risks, not a Fail. Optional hardening: in the unread criterion have both Dev contexts and Gwen explicitly open M-11 before reading M-13's count and read counts from the matter list; in live_updates have the judge note the thread's scroll offset (or the top visible message) before Harriet acts.
